title: Fuzzy RDD: imperfect compliance with admission cutoff

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy
Fuzzy Regression Discontinuity Design (RDD) using cutoff crossing as an instrument for actual scholarship receipt. The key assumptions are: (1) continuity of potential outcomes at the cutoff, (2) monotonicity (crossing the cutoff weakly increases probability of treatment for all units), and (3) exclusion restriction (cutoff crossing affects outcomes only through scholarship receipt). This identifies the Local Average Treatment Effect (LATE) for compliers.

## 2. R Code
```r
# Load required libraries
library(rdrobust)
library(AER)

# Read the data
data <- read.csv("experiments/exp_b/data/s30_data.csv")

# Create the eligibility instrument (z) based on cutoff at 0.5
data$z <- as.numeric(data$running_var >= 0.5)

# Center running variable at cutoff
data$running_var_centered <- data$running_var - 0.5

# Check first stage relationship
first_stage <- lm(treated ~ z + running_var_centered + I(running_var_centered * z), data = data)
cat("First Stage Results:\n")
print(summary(first_stage))
cat("\nFirst Stage F-statistic:", summary(first_stage)$fstatistic[1], "\n")

# Reduced form (intent-to-treat effect)
reduced_form <- lm(y ~ z + running_var_centered + I(running_var_centered * z), data = data)
cat("\nReduced Form Results:\n")
print(summary(reduced_form))

# Fuzzy RDD using 2SLS
fuzzy_rdd <- ivreg(y ~ treated + running_var_centered + I(running_var_centered * treated) | 
                   z + running_var_centered + I(running_var_centered * z), data = data)
cat("\nFuzzy RDD (2SLS) Results:\n")
print(summary(fuzzy_rdd))

# Extract LATE estimate
late_estimate <- coef(fuzzy_rdd)["treated"]
late_se <- summary(fuzzy_rdd)$coefficients["treated", "Std. Error"]
cat("\nLATE Estimate (Main Result):", round(late_estimate, 4), "\n")
cat("Standard Error:", round(late_se, 4), "\n")
cat("95% Confidence Interval: [", round(late_estimate - 1.96*late_se, 4), ",", 
    round(late_estimate + 1.96*late_se, 4), "]\n")

# Robustness checks
cat("\n=== ROBUSTNESS CHECKS ===\n")

# 1. Alternative bandwidth (subset to near cutoff)
fuzzy_rdd_narrow <- ivreg(y ~ treated + running_var_centered + I(running_var_centered * treated) | 
                          z + running_var_centered + I(running_var_centered * z), 
                          data = subset(data, near_cutoff == 1))
cat("1. Narrow bandwidth LATE:", round(coef(fuzzy_rdd_narrow)["treated"], 4), "\n")

# 2. Linear specification without interaction
fuzzy_rdd_linear <- ivreg(y ~ treated + running_var_centered | 
                          z + running_var_centered, data = data)
cat("2. Linear (no interaction) LATE:", round(coef(fuzzy_rdd_linear)["treated"], 4), "\n")

# 3. Check compliance rates
compliance_above <- mean(data$treated[data$z == 1])
compliance_below <- mean(data$treated[data$z == 0])
cat("3. Compliance above cutoff:", round(compliance_above, 3), "\n")
cat("   Compliance below cutoff:", round(compliance_below, 3), "\n")
cat("   Jump in treatment probability:", round(compliance_above - compliance_below, 3), "\n")

# 4. Manual Wald estimator
itt_effect <- coef(reduced_form)["z"]
first_stage_jump <- coef(first_stage)["z"]
wald_estimate <- itt_effect / first_stage_jump
cat("4. Manual Wald estimator:", round(wald_estimate, 4), "\n")
```

## 3. Expected Findings
I expect a positive LATE estimate around 0.3-0.6, indicating that receiving the scholarship increases graduation probability by 30-60 percentage points for compliers. The scholarship should improve academic outcomes through reduced financial stress and increased motivation. The fuzzy design will show imperfect compliance (treatment probability jumping from ~20-40% to ~70-90% at the cutoff), with the LATE being larger in magnitude than the intent-to-treat effect due to incomplete takeup.

_ground_truth.identification_strategy: Fuzzy RDD — eligibility cutoff as IV for scholarship receipt; LATE = ITT / first-stage jump
_ground_truth.conclusion_detail: Scholarship receipt significantly improves graduation rates for compliers
_ground_truth.main_effect: ~25pp graduation rate increase (LATE via fuzzy RDD)
